assumption_ledger.note: Release notes mention removing the shim but no explicit task or timeline is provided; assuming removal happens after RN-101 audit.
No duration specified for canary validation period before RN-104 runbook update.

dependency_notes.reason: Schema audit must complete before fixtures can be written to match the correct schema.
Dashboard summary must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema.
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary.

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with concrete field mappings and impact assessment.
ordered_steps.summary: Identify and document schema drift between translator output and legacy parser shim expectations before removing the shim.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated test fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that pass with new step ids.
ordered_steps.summary: Add test fixtures reflecting the new schema so plan contract tests catch ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature toggled on for canary with kill switch for rollback.
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after the schema is stable.
ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook and checklist reflecting actual rollout shape.
ordered_steps.summary: Document rollout and rollback procedures once the dashboard summary is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Complete schema audit (RN-101) before any dashboard work.
Add dependency-graph fixtures (RN-102) to catch ordering regressions in tests.
Use kill switch (RN-103) for immediate rollback if dashboard issues appear.
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or unstable step ordering if schema drift is not resolved before enabling the summary.
